embeds.title: WELCOME TO THE BEER LEAGUE HOCKEY ASSOCIATION
embeds.description:
**BLHA** is a 12-franchise dynasty fantasy hockey league built around long-term roster construction, prospect development, an active trade market, daily competition, and permanent league history.

**Fantrax runs the game. Discord runs the league.**
